Accra, imagined study

A Room for Noon.

An imagined interior study about daylight, shadow and the hours when a room feels most alive.

Theme
Light and enclosure

Format
Editorial concept

Study
Imagined

At noon, light becomes a material. A broad opening draws the sky deep into the room, while timber surfaces soften its glare.

The furniture follows the quieter edges. There is space to step away from direct sunlight without losing a sense of the outside.

An interior has more than one atmosphere.

Morning draws long patterns across the floor; by afternoon the same room gathers its light closer to the walls. The project is an imagined study of those small changes.
